back.prompt:
Create a production animation sprite sheet for the EXACT miniature hooded adventurer in the attached directional reference. This is a single-direction animation asset; keep that viewing angle locked in every cell.
Contemporary browser adventure artwork, flat opaque colors, three discrete cel-shading bands, thin colored outlines, clean silhouette, no texture noise, no gradients, no pastel wash, no photorealism.
GENUINE TRANSPARENT background. EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equal rectangular cells on a perfectly regular grid, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Portrait overall canvas aspect 3:4. NO visible grid, NO text, NO numbers, NO panels or shadows. Place one whole figure in each cell, with 12% safe padding between silhouettes. Same character scale in ALL cells: hood/head dimensions, face, torso, bow, reel, boots must be identical. Airborne poses still use the same underlying body scale; animation height comes from the game, not extra empty padding. Never enlarge a crouch to fill its cell.
Identity: vermilion hood and short red cape, navy tunic, chunky dark warm brown boots, compact brass chain reel always on anatomical RIGHT hip, small wooden bow always held in anatomical LEFT hand. Upper-left light and thin colored contours match reference. 2.25 heads tall, compact original miniature adventurer.

Row 1 cells1–4 = first half of WALK cycle: left foot forward contact / left foot planted with mild knee compression / right leg passing left leg under body / rising with right foot about to plant. Bow carried relaxed in left hand, cape subtly follows step.
Row 2 cells5–8 = second half WALK cycle: right foot forward contact / right foot planted with mild knee compression / left leg passing right under body / rising with left foot about to plant. The eight frames must be a continuous natural alternating walk cycle; never switch viewing direction.

Make all 16 poses distinct and mechanically believable, maintain exact face and equipment identity. We will crop each equal cell directly: every limb, bow and cloak must stay inside its own cell and have real transparent separation. No extra sprites.
